subject: Refactor Enter key multi-connection open logic to reduce cognitive load.
body:
Refactor Enter key multi-connection open logic to reduce cognitive load.

Extracted logic for opening multiple connections with Enter into helper methods for improved readability and maintainability. The event handler now delegates to HandleEnterKeyMultiSelect(), which opens selected connections or, if none, direct children of selected folders. Helper methods encapsulate selection logic, and GetDirectChildConnections() is now static. No functional changes to behavior.

triage.rationale: Refactors the OpenMultipleConnectionsWithEnter feature, which is not implemented in our fork, causing compilation failures.
